rules.text: Will Breaker: a failing creature takes −1 on its next Strength or Dexterity save (−2 at 11th).

castOption.label: Onijutsu: Will Breaker (1 Oni-Coil)
castOption.note: a failing creature takes −1 on its next Strength or Dexterity save (−2 at 11th).

system.description: When an affected creature fails their saving throw against the amplified Genjutsu, their bodies ability to resist harm suffers as well. They suffer a -1 penalty to their next Strength or Dexterity saving throw. This increases to -2 at 11th level.
